# Reth-Gnosis compatibility port

This directory supplies EEZ's Gnosis execution client integration. Source
provenance and local changes are documented in [the vendor guide](../README.md).
Build the consuming EEZ packages from the repository root with `--locked`.

Upstream deployment scripts, Docker builds and CI are omitted from this library
copy. For standalone Gnosis node operation and upstream tests, consult the
[original repository at the imported revision](https://github.com/gnosischain/reth_gnosis/tree/3482cbe6ed962830d71b154773c9209267edf1dd).
